_comment: Tool schemas offered to the model on a `tool` row, by set name. The suite's
attachment column names a set as `tools:NAME` and the runner puts that set in
Nothing here is executed. The server is launched without --tools, so it holds
no tool server and runs no command; what these declarations produce is a
`tool_calls` object in the response, and the graders read that object. Tool
selection is therefore measured with the appliance's read-only boundary
intact rather than relaxed for the measurement.
The sets are small on purpose. A model choosing among two or three tools is
the case the appliance would present; a set of twenty measures a retrieval
problem the appliance does not have.
